query:
INSERT INTO "TrafficLog" (id, "clientId", "nodeId", upload, download, protocol, "inboundTag")
           SELECT u.id, u."clientId", u."nodeId", u.upload, u.download,
                  NULLIF(u.protocol, '')::"Protocol", NULLIF(u."inboundTag", '')
           FROM UNNEST($1::text[], $2::text[], $3::text[], $4::bigint[], $5::bigint[],
                       $6::text[], $7::text[])
             AS u(id, "clientId", "nodeId", upload, download, protocol, "inboundTag")
